title: Omnipod "Pump" (Orange/EmaLink) battery age not shown (Not urgent)
symptom: AAPS 2.8.1.1 shows the battery level of the Orangelink, but when noting 'Pump battery change' with a date on the Actions page, the information is noted on the care portal but not shown in the actions page. The user wants the battery age to be displayed for Orangelink.
cause: The thread discusses that the battery age display is intended for pump battery, but for Omnipod (EROS) the pump battery is not readable, so the age is not shown. For Orangelink, the battery level is readable but the age is not tracked.
fix: For Omnipod EROS, the age should work when the 'Change battery pump' action is performed, but the action button is only available when enabled through preferences. For Dash, the battery section will be hidden completely (as per PR #1328).
evidence_quote: For Omnipod EROS, the age should be working, when the "Change battery pump" action is performed. Change action button is only available for EROS when enabled through the preferences. For Dash battery section in action and overview status light will be hidden completely
